links.outcome: Flesch-Kincaid reading grade level of LLM responses to otologic patient questions
links.effect: ChatGPT mean grade 7.25 (most readable); ClaudeAI 11.86 (more complex, p<.05). LLM readability rated higher than physicians (4.00 vs 3.73).
links.quote: By Flesch-Kincaid grade level, ChatGPT produced the most readable content (mean 7.25), while ClaudeAI responses were more complex (11.86; p < .05).

unlisted_practices: Blinded comparison of LLM responses with verified physician responses on quality and empathy ratings
Evaluator ability to distinguish AI from physician responses

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM responses compared to physician responses to otology queries scraped from Reddit, assessing quality, empathy, and readability without testing a specific organizational deployment safeguard.
